bpp.poco.axf5q_5mm.name: Research-cell BPP — POCO AXF-5Q graphite, 5 mm

thickness.note: 5 mm is a project-convention research-cell BPP thickness — POCO AXF-5Q is sold by Entegris as semi-finished blocks/plates that are machined to size. Other common research-cell thicknesses: 3 mm, 10 mm. The material properties come from entegris.datasheet.axf5q via the material reference.
